chunks: One of our companions, from Muhammad ibn al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from Mansur, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When the Tila' (residue of evaporated grape juice) increases upon the one-third by one Awqiya (a unit of measurement), so it is Prohibited.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on Tila' when it exceeds one-third by an Awqiya?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the threshold for the impurity (najasa) of Tila', the grape residue used in vinegar production, establishing that exceeding one-third by a single Awqiya renders it impure. This ruling is pivotal in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between pure and impure grape derivatives, reflecting the meticulous attention to quantitative purity standards in early Ja'fari jurisprudence. It underscores the practical application of weight-based measurements in determining the ritual status of foodstuffs.
